francesca_mahajan_raw.json.text:
{{Infobox character |games =FOTV |image =FOTV Vault 31 Cryobay.png |race =[[Human]] |gender =Female |family = |location =[[Vault 31]] |role =Junior executive |affiliation =[[Vault 31]]/[[Vault-Tec Corporation]] |TV actor = |dod = |dod verified= }} '''Francesca Mahajan''' is a pre-War junior executive of the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] who was part of the "[[Bud's Buds]]" program in [[Vault 31]]. ==Background== Mahajan was a Vault-Tec junior employee selected to participate in [[Bud Askins]]' executive assistant training program "[[Bud's Buds]]," a plan to create "super managers" who would define the future of humanity after the [[Great War]] wiped out all competitors to Vault-Tec. Mahajan and the other Buds would be kept in [[Cryonics|cryostasis]] in Vault 31, periodically thawed out, and transferred to Vault 32 or 33 to manage the dwellers and participate in controlled breeding (eugenics), all under Askins' supervision.[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"So what's Vault 32 and 33? Just people to be controlled?"''
[[Bud Askins]]: ''"What? No! When you put it like that, it sounds downright morally questionable. They're our breeding pool, the ultimate expression of HR R&D. Genetically selected to breed with my Buds to create a class of super managers. People with positivity, people who make lemonade. People who will inherit the Earth after we've wiped the surface clean."''
("[[The Beginning]]")

'''Frank''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
Frank and [[Frank's daughter|his daughter]] accepted an invitation to [[Roy Spencer]]'s birthday party.<ref name="FalloutTV">{{fotv|1|A1}}</ref>

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The End (episode)|The End]]===
Frank stands beside [[Bob Spencer]] as they watch [[Cooper Howard]] finish his lasso performance for the [[birthday party guest|party guests]]. He then asks Bob why someone as famous as Cooper Howard would be performing birthday shows, and Bob answers that it's to pay off his alimony. Frank continues to stand by Bob when he takes a picture of Cooper with his wife [[Ronda Spencer|Ronda]].<ref name="FalloutTV" />

After Cooper takes his money from Mrs. Spencer and walks away with [[Sugarfoot]] and his daughter [[Janey Howard|Janey]], Frank remarks that Cooper is a "[[communism|pinko]]." Bob agrees and comments that he still took the money.<ref name="FalloutTV" />

Afterward, all the party attendees sing happy birthday to Roy in the living room, and he blows out the candle on his cake. '''Frank's daughter''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The End (episode)|The End]]===
At [[Roy Spencer]]'s birthday party, Frank's daughter sits amongst the [[birthday party guest]]s and watches [[The Ghoul|Cooper Howard]] perform a lasso trick for them all on his horse, [[Sugarfoot]].

Afterward, she joins the other party guests to watch TV in the living room until the bomb with the far away distance drops. After this, she follows her father [[Frank (TV series)|Frank]] to try and join the Spencer family in their fallout shelter. However, Roy's father [[Bob Spencer|Bob]] punches out her father and leaves him on the ground.

==Appearances==
Frank's daughter appears only {{in|FOTV}}.
